name: MonitoringStationRecord
description: A hydrological monitoring station record demonstrating three coordinate reference system bindings. Two nested objects carry the same horizontal position under two different encodings — OGC CRS84 (longitude-first axis order) and EPSG:4326 (latitude-first axis order) — so that the axis-order contrast is explicit in each coordinates array. The enclosing record carries the EPSG:5703 NAVD88 vertical CRS binding for the station benchmark elevation. Because an object or tuple may carry at most one coordinateReferenceSystem annotation, any second coordinate binding must be modelled as a nested object; both horizontal position objects are nested here for exactly that reason.

stationName.description: Human-readable name of the monitoring station

reportedAt.description: RFC 3339 date-time at which this record was published

benchmarkElevation.description: Station benchmark elevation in metres. The axis direction and datum origin are established by the referenced EPSG:5703 definition; this annotation identifies the binding and does not authorize comparison with heights in other vertical datums.

crs84Position.description: Horizontal position encoded in OGC CRS84. Axis 1 of CRS84 is longitude (degrees East) and axis 2 is latitude (degrees North), so the coordinates array maps lon to axis 1 and lat to axis 2. The numeric values in an instance are identical to those in epsg4326Position; the coordinates array is the sole record of which property supplies which axis.

lon.description: Geodetic longitude in decimal degrees, positive East of the prime meridian

lat.description: Geodetic latitude in decimal degrees, positive North of the equator

epsg4326Position.description: The same physical point encoded in EPSG:4326. Axis 1 of EPSG:4326 is latitude (degrees North) and axis 2 is longitude (degrees East), which is the reverse of CRS84. The coordinates array therefore maps lat to axis 1 and lon to axis 2. The numeric values of lat and lon are the same as in crs84Position; only the axis assignment stated by coordinates differs.

lat.description: Geodetic latitude in decimal degrees, positive North of the equator

lon.description: Geodetic longitude in decimal degrees, positive East of the prime meridian
